", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0054", "tag": "p", "text": "“Look!” she commanded.", "sha256": "79f90b4fdef88600adf7e04dd9f1fcb37b1fbd3a5ffe3d070d5414c25b635b10", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1695]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0055", "tag": "p", "text": "And Torres, approaching the great bowl, gazed into it. What he saw, the rest of his party never learned. And what Torres himself saw was a bedroom and a birth in the second story of the Bocas del Toro house he had inherited. Pitiful it was, with its last secrecy exposed, as was the gently smiling pity in the Queen’s face.
